podcast.body: Firefall's song "Just Remember I Love You" is noted for its similarity to Poco's "Crazy Love," suggesting a shared musical style or influence within the country rock genre. "Definitely reminds me of Poco, kind of like Crazy Love."

srcs.episode: Ep. 49 - Austin City Limits and the 70s Country Music Revolution

podcast.body: Released in November 1978 from the album "Legend," this song became Poco's first major hit, reaching number one on the Billboard Adult Contemporary charts for seven weeks and number seventeen on the Billboard Hot 100, marking their first top forty hit. It was released during a period when new singles were typically avoided due to Christmas music programming, which provided an open lane for its success on the Adult Contemporary chart. "It was crazy love that saved polko in nineteen seventy eight and finally gave them the hit that they never had."
